cohort: The study included 1066 consecutive non-diabetic women who delivered babies weighing 4000g or more.
finding: Gardosi curves showed better performance than Intergrowth21 curves in predicting the risk of Cesarean section, and induction of labor was significantly associated with adverse outcomes in non-diabetic women with large for gestational age babies.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was significantly associated with instrumental delivery, Cesarean section, third and fourth degree perineal tears, and post-partum hemorrhage.
